title: Add project display to TUI
description:
Enhance TUI to show project information:

- Show current project in header/status bar when --project flag used
- Show project of selected epic in task pane
- Add filter indicator when project filter is active
- Optionally show project column in task list
closed_reason: Added project display to TUI: (1) Config and Model fields for EpicProject and ProjectFilter, (2) Status bar shows project code in purple [PROJECT] format with (filtered) indicator when --project flag is active, (3) Task pane shows 'Project: CODE' line below header when epic has a project, (4) EpicInfo struct includes Project field for picker display. Tests added for all new rendering features.
